summary.root_cause_text: Payment provider at internal://payments-v1 times out for every call since order 14, so orders are marked processed without a payment. The cause of the timeout is unknown. It is either a provider outage or a wrong URL.
recommended: Check the payment provider's health and find the correct endpoint. If the URL is wrong, set payment_provider_url to the correct value.
Once the provider is reachable, run reprocess_orders with all_unpaid, then run check_invariants.
Consider pausing order intake until payments work. Restarting the worker does not help while the provider is down.
